scope: P8.4; offline interpretation of existing verified outputs, not a new study or inferential analysis
summaries: all twelve main profiles per dataset/model; min/max of existing cell estimates and paired deltas; these ranges are NOT confidence intervals
uncertainty: retain original per-cell/per-pair source-cluster and question-sensitivity intervals; no newly pooled interval, significance counting, winner selection or tuning
timing: stage generation share is generation mean divided by total online mean per cell, not a mean request ratio; exclude baselines from the main range
controls: separate gold/no-RAG tables; no pooling baseline/main timing implementations or historical runs
validation: python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_synthesis.py -v; independently recompute every summary range/count and check all source proof hashes
command: python -m ragbench_lab study-synthesis --analysis-dir reports/stage-b-analysis-v1 --analysis-proof artifacts/stage-b-analysis-verification-v1.json --figure-dir reports/stage-b-figures-v1 --figure-proof artifacts/stage-b-figures-verification-v1.json --review-dir reports/stage-b-failure-review-v1 --review-proof artifacts/stage-b-failure-review-verification-v1.json --protocol configs/synthesis-protocol.json --output NEW_DIRECTORY
